title: Oven Roasted Australian Lamb Sandwich
description: A cultured and tender Australian dish featuring roasted lamb and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, served on double-rise-bread with a hint of sansho pepper.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and sansho pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then transfer to the oven.
Roast the lamb in the oven for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing thinly.
Toast the double-rise-bread slices until lightly browned.
Assemble the sandwich by spreading a layer of garlic on each bread slice, then topping with sliced lamb, rosemary, and a drizzle of olive oil.
